conn_wizard_intro_pick: How would you like Birkly to send email? Pick the option that matches your situation.
conn_wizard_intro_tip: Not sure? Use Log only on your computer to try things out, or Resend / Postmark for production sites.
conn_wizard_name_help: A label you will recognize in the list — only you see this.
conn_wizard_from_email_help: Recipients see this as the “From” address.
conn_wizard_alias_help: Leave blank to auto-generate. Plugins use this to pick a specific connection.
conn_wizard_intro_test: Send yourself a quick test to make sure everything works.
conn_wizard_default_label: Use this as the default email connection for form notifications, Commerce, and other features
conn_wizard_default_help: You can change the default later from the connection list.
conn_http_reference_help: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
content_groups_first_message: Collections hold your site content — blog posts, products, pages, and more. Start from scratch or install a starter template.

content_groups_delete_group_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this group? Collections will be moved to ungrouped.
